items.html: Nevertheless, it is necessarily so that even though they are only the phases of the Nekudot, there is within them a phase that connects with the Taamim of MA, and a phase that connects with the Nekudot of MA, and likewise with the other divisions, although together they are all only phases of the Nekudot of SAG. And through the connection of the name MA with it, these Nekudot were now corrected and became females to them; therefore they are called by the name Melachim [kings], from the language of Malchut, to indicate that they became a female to the name MA of Alephs.
